preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: If no valid graph can be constructed, output 'Impossible'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices and cannot be a self-loop.
